title: A better view of what people are making
summary:
A new image feed and React audio hook landed while Z-Image gained upscaling and became the default image model.

The Play page added a Watch Feed with single-image and grid views, showing completed images across models with prompt and model labels. The Model Monitor table also became horizontally scrollable on mobile, so its latency and error columns are no longer cut off.

Z-Image added SPAN 2× upscaling for requests above its native pixel budget, while preserving aspect ratios when oversized requests are scaled down. Its native resolution budget was subsequently reduced, and generation now uses a fixed nine steps. Z-Image also replaced flux as the default image model; requests using `flux` now resolve to Z-Image.

`@pollinations/react` added `usePollinationsAudio` for building text-to-speech URLs from text, with voice, model, and seed options. A follow-up added its TypeScript definition.

daily.title: Watch the image feed
daily.text: Browse completed community images in a single-image or grid view, with prompts and model labels. The feed follows images across models, regardless of which model you selected in Play. [Open Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

daily.title: Text-to-speech in React
daily.text: Use `usePollinationsAudio` to build a speech URL from text, with optional voice, model, and seed settings. The hook also has TypeScript definitions. [Explore React SDK & UI](https://react.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Larger Z-Image outputs
daily.text: Z-Image can use SPAN 2× upscaling when a requested image exceeds its native pixel budget, giving you a larger output while preserving the requested aspect ratio within output limits. [Browse Z-Image](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=zimage).

daily.title: Z-Image becomes the default
daily.text: Image requests now default to `zimage`. Requests specifying `flux` resolve to Z-Image too, so existing calls using that name select a different model. [Browse Z-Image](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=zimage).
